# Let's get all pages of Venmo friends.
all_venmo_friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_login['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_venmo_friends.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
